title: ContinuityOps supervisor review verdict (BF-PRE-015)
description: Committed as evidence/slices/<slice>/SUPERVISOR_VERDICT.json when the portfolio supervisor reviews a signaled stream branch. The verdict is a durable file, never chat-only feedback. Free-text values are Simplified Chinese.

decision.description: approve certifies the signaled branch for the next step; rework returns it with issue IDs

candidate_sha.description: The exact 40-hex candidate the verdict binds to; a new candidate SHA invalidates this verdict

reviewed_paths.description: The write_scope paths and evidence files the supervisor actually inspected

issue_ids.description: Empty on approve; on rework, the durable issue IDs the orchestrator must resolve
